title: windows: safely deduplicate/reclaim space without breaking hardlinks or CoW
scenario: On windows, an expert-level problem demanding deep causal reasoning: Devi recuperare spazio deduplicando file identici, ma senza rompere hardlink esistenti o la semantica copy-on-write. Recupera in sicurezza. Multiple plausible causes; only evidence separates them.

environment.task: safely deduplicate/reclaim space without breaking hardlinks or CoW

initial_state: # fixture: windows host prepared for 'safely deduplicate/reclaim space without breaking hardlinks or CoW'
expected_reasoning: Naive dedup (replace-with-link) can break apps that assume independent files or CoW semantics.
Understand which files are safe to link (truly immutable) vs those needing independent copies.
Dedup only the safe set (reflink/CoW where available); verify no app breaks and space is reclaimed.
expected_commands: # windows-appropriate deep-diagnosis + remediation for: safely deduplicate/reclaim space without breaking hardlinks or CoW
safety_constraints: Gather evidence before any irreversible action.
Preserve data/evidence; snapshot before destructive steps.
Fix the root cause and add a guardrail; never trade long-term integrity for a quick unblock.
success_criteria: The expert problem 'safely deduplicate/reclaim space without breaking hardlinks or CoW' is resolved at the root, verified with evidence, with data/integrity preserved.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Every irreversible action sits behind a captured rollback point (image/snapshot/backup).

ground_truth.task: safely deduplicate/reclaim space without breaking hardlinks or CoW

possible_mistakes: Hardlink files that get edited independently, causing cross-contamination.
hints: reflink/CoW dedup is safe for mutable files; hardlink is not.
alternative_solution: Use filesystem-native dedup (ZFS/Btrfs) instead of manual linking.
edge_cases: A backup tool follows hardlinks and now stores less independence than expected.
goal: Devi recuperare spazio deduplicando file identici, ma senza rompere hardlink esistenti o la semantica copy-on-write. Recupera in sicurezza.
